```{python}
#| label: fig-pnr-flow
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Standard-cell place-and-route flow with open-source tools: placement and routing (openroad) use the library and technology data (LEF); parasitic extraction (openrcx) delivers a SPEF file for post-layout timing analysis (opensta); after timing, noise, and reliability checks pass, the layout is streamed out as GDSII (klayout, magic) and sent to the manufacturer. Timing failures loop back to placement."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyArrowPatch, FancyBboxPatch, Polygon


def box(ax, x, y, text, w=3.2, h=1.0, kind='proc'):
    if kind == 'term':
        # shrink by the pad so the padded outer edge matches w x h exactly
        p = 0.08
        ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x - w / 2 + p, y - h / 2 + p),
                                    w - 2 * p, h - 2 * p,
                                    boxstyle=f'round,pad={p}',
                                    fc='#f4e8d8', ec='k', lw=1.0))
    elif kind == 'data':
        ax.add_patch(Polygon([(x - w / 2 + 0.3, y - h / 2),
                              (x + w / 2 + 0.3, y - h / 2),
                              (x + w / 2 - 0.3, y + h / 2),
                              (x - w / 2 - 0.3, y + h / 2)],
                             closed=True, fc='#e8f4e8', ec='k', lw=1.0))
    elif kind == 'dec':
        ax.add_patch(Polygon([(x - w / 2, y), (x, y + h / 2 + 0.2),
                              (x + w / 2, y), (x, y - h / 2 - 0.2)],
                             closed=True, fc='#fdf3d0', ec='k', lw=1.0))
    else:
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x - w / 2, y - h / 2), w, h, fc='#e8eef4',
                               ec='k', lw=1.0))
    ax.text(x, y, text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8)


def arr(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, label=None):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x0, y0), (x1, y1), arrowstyle='->',
                                 mutation_scale=11, lw=1.0,
                                 shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0))
    if label:
        ax.text((x0 + x1) / 2 + 0.15, (y0 + y1) / 2, label, fontsize=8)


fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6.8))

# left column
box(ax, 2.5, 10.8, 'Netlist', kind='term')
box(ax, 2.5, 9.3, 'Placement\n(openroad)')
box(ax, 2.5, 7.8, 'Routing\n(openroad)')
box(ax, 2.5, 6.3, 'Parasitic extraction\n(openrcx)')
box(ax, 2.5, 4.8, 'SPEF', kind='data', w=2.0)
arr(ax, 2.5, 10.3, 2.5, 9.8)
arr(ax, 2.5, 8.8, 2.5, 8.3)
arr(ax, 2.5, 7.3, 2.5, 6.8)
arr(ax, 2.5, 5.8, 2.5, 5.3)

# library inputs
box(ax, 6.6, 9.3, 'Library + technology\ndata (LEF)', kind='data')
arr(ax, 5.0, 9.3, 4.1, 9.3)
ax.plot([4.7, 4.7], [9.3, 7.8], 'k-', lw=1.0)
arr(ax, 4.7, 7.8, 4.1, 7.8)

# right column
box(ax, 7.5, 4.8, 'Timing analysis\n(opensta)')
box(ax, 7.5, 3.3, 'OK?', w=1.6, h=0.8, kind='dec')
box(ax, 7.5, 1.8, 'Noise + reliability\nchecks')
box(ax, 11.5, 1.8, 'Streamout GDSII\n(klayout, magic)')
box(ax, 11.5, 0.3, 'Database to manufacturer', kind='term', w=3.9)
arr(ax, 3.5, 4.8, 5.9, 4.8)
arr(ax, 7.5, 4.3, 7.5, 3.9)
arr(ax, 7.5, 2.7, 7.5, 2.3, 'y')
arr(ax, 9.1, 1.8, 9.9, 1.8)
arr(ax, 11.5, 1.3, 11.5, 0.8)
# loop back on 'n' to placement
ax.plot([8.3, 9.6, 9.6], [3.3, 3.3, 11.9], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.plot([9.6, 0.5, 0.5], [11.9, 11.9, 9.3], 'k-', lw=1.0)
arr(ax, 0.5, 9.3, 0.9, 9.3)
ax.text(8.6, 3.5, 'n', fontsize=8)

ax.set_xlim(0.2, 13.8)
ax.set_ylim(-0.4, 12.2)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
